**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

- **§ 28.1** — governed by the laws of the State of New York, CISG disclaimed.
- **§ 28.2** — exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/forum objections.
- **§ 28.3** — mutual pre-filing executive escalation (15 business days) that expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings.

This matches the playbook's **preferred** position (New York law + exclusive New York County courts). A document-wide search for "arbitration" returned no results, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration risk, and the injunctive-relief carve-out in § 28.2 is bilateral and benefits us equally.
